flags: The homepage claims to be 'fully compliant with HIPAA requirements,' but the Privacy Policy explicitly excludes HIPAA-covered health information from scope. No BAA or HIPAA-covered entity designation is documented.
SOC 1 is mentioned on the homepage, but detailed information is only available for SOC 2 Type II on the /security page. No SOC 1 Type I or Type II designation was found.
Nudge Security's aggregator claims ISO 27001, PCI DSS, FedRamp, and CSA STAR Level 1 compliance, but these are not mentioned on eBrevia's vendor-domain pages (ebrevia.com).
The privacy policy does not address whether customer contracts or extracted data are used to train or improve AI models.
No Data Processing Agreement (DPA) is mentioned in the Terms or Privacy Policy.
eBrevia has no dedicated trust or compliance center page; security and compliance information is scattered across the homepage, /security, /privacy-policy, and /data-privacy pages.
Vendor identity: eBrevia, Inc., Delaware corporation, 1800 Le Jeune Road, Coral Gables, FL 33134 USA.
